source_article.role: Discovery source; financial terms checked against SEC filing

primary_sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Oklo Inc.
primary_sources.evidence: Oklo Power SODI LLC entered into a HALEU Supply Agreement with Centrus on November 11. It calls for two prepayments totaling $35 million, credited against future purchases and representing a portion of the amounts payable. Enrichment-service purchases for deliveries during 2029 through 2031 are on a take-or-pay basis subject to conditions. Prepayments are intended to support Centrus's commercial HALEU enrichment capacity at Piketon, Ohio.

primary_sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Oklo Inc.
primary_sources.evidence: Underlying agreement; some commercial terms and payment timing are redacted.

verified_facts.credited_against: Future purchases under the fuel supply agreement
verified_facts.capacity_status: Commercial HALEU enrichment capacity under construction/development

factual_limits: $35 million describes aggregate contractual prepayments, not the total contract value.
Actual payment status is not asserted; the first specified payment date is redacted and a second payment is linked to a commercial milestone.
No claim that fuel has been delivered, new capacity is completed, or an Oklo reactor is operating.
November 17 was the filing/new financial disclosure, not the agreement signing date.
No investment recommendation, stock-return claim, contract-profit estimate, or comparison with cash reserves.
